title: Glimpse of Paradise: Srinagar & Gulmarg
shortDescription: Ideal for a quick escape. Discover Dal Lake on a sunset Shikara ride, stay in a heritage houseboat, and experience the world-famed Gulmarg Gondola.
fullDescription: The perfect introduction to the crown jewel of the Himalayas. Over 4 unforgettable days, you will experience the timeless tranquility of Srinagar's water world and the majestic alpine splendor of Gulmarg. Glide silently through the lotus channels of Dal Lake during a Shikara ride, sleep in an authentic cedar houseboat adorned with Kashmiri craft, wander among terraced fountains at Nishat and Shalimar Mughal Gardens, and take an exhilarating cable car ride on the Gulmarg Gondola surrounded by snow-dusted peaks.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Srinagar & Sunset Shikara on Dal Lake
itinerary.description: Warm traditional welcome at Srinagar International Airport by our City Line representative. Transfer to your luxury houseboat or premium hotel on Dal Lake. In the late afternoon, embark on an enchanting 1-hour Shikara ride across the mirrored waters of Dal Lake, visiting floating gardens and Nehru Park as the sunset paints the mountains in gold.
itinerary.stay: Overnight in Luxury Houseboat / Hotel, Srinagar

itinerary.title: Day Excursion to the Alpine Meadows of Gulmarg
itinerary.description: After a hearty breakfast, embark on a scenic drive to Gulmarg (54 km / 2 hrs) passing through pastoral Kashmiri villages and apple orchards. Board the world-famous Gulmarg Gondola (Phase 1 to Kongdoori and optional Phase 2 to Apharwat Peak at 14,000 ft). Enjoy snowball activities, pony rides, or admire the pristine pine woods. Return to Srinagar in the evening.

itinerary.title: Historic Mughal Gardens & Old Srinagar Heritage Tour
itinerary.description: Spend the day exploring the architectural grandeur of Srinagar's Royal Mughal Gardens: Nishat Bagh (Garden of Pleasure), Shalimar Bagh (Abode of Love), and the natural spring at Chashme Shahi. In the afternoon, visit Shankaracharya Temple for panoramic city views, followed by shopping in the old bazaar for authentic Kashmiri saffron, dry fruits, and pashmina shawls.

itinerary.title: Departure from Srinagar with Fond Memories
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast admiring morning views over Dal Lake. Depending on your flight schedule, our dedicated vehicle will transfer you to Srinagar International Airport for your onward journey, leaving with memories that will stay with you forever.

title: Kashmir Classic Honeymoon: Romance in the Valley
shortDescription: Designed for lovers. Candlelit dinner on a luxury houseboat, flower-decorated room, Shikara romance, snow peaks of Gulmarg, and riverside walks in Pahalgam.
fullDescription: Begin your journey of togetherness in the most romantic sanctuary on Earth. This handcrafted honeymoon package combines intimate privacy with majestic mountain vistas. Experience a special candle-lit dinner with special cake and flower bed decoration inside a hand-carved heritage houseboat on Dal Lake. Walk hand-in-hand through the verdant pine groves of Betaab Valley and Aru Valley in Pahalgam, and ride into the clouds aboard the Gulmarg Gondola.

itinerary.title: Welcome to Srinagar & Romantic Houseboat Stay
itinerary.description: Arrival at Srinagar Airport with a floral welcome. Transfer to your premium luxury houseboat on Dal Lake. Enjoy authentic Kashmiri Kahwa upon arrival. In the evening, a special romantic Shikara ride followed by a candlelit dinner with honeymoon cake and fresh flower bed decoration.
itinerary.stay: Overnight in Luxury Houseboat, Dal Lake

itinerary.title: Srinagar to Gulmarg: Valley of Lovers
itinerary.description: Drive from Srinagar to Gulmarg. Check in to your cozy resort overlooking pine ridges. Spend the afternoon taking leisurely walks through the flower-filled meadows, visiting St. Mary's church, and enjoying views of Apharwat peak.

itinerary.title: Gulmarg Gondola Cloud Ride & Alpine Wonders
itinerary.description: Board the famous Gulmarg Gondola up into the high alpine zone. Marvel at snow-clad Himalayan giants, enjoy snow adventures together, and savor warm Kashmiri cuisine at mountain-top cafes. Return to hotel for a warm fireside evening.

itinerary.title: Gulmarg to Pahalgam: Along Saffron Fields & Lidder River
itinerary.description: Drive to Pahalgam (approx. 4 hrs). En route, pause at the historic Pampore saffron fields and the ancient Avantipur ruins. As you reach Pahalgam, check in to a riverside hotel where the melody of the Lidder river serenades you.

itinerary.title: Exploring Betaab Valley, Aru Valley & Baisaran
itinerary.description: Dedicate the day to Pahalgam's most romantic valleys. Visit Betaab Valley, famed for its emerald carpet and crystal streams, and Aru Valley with its quiet alpine charm. Optional pony ride to Baisaran ('Mini Switzerland'). Return to Srinagar in late afternoon.

itinerary.title: Mughal Gardens & Airport Departure
itinerary.description: Morning visit to Nishat and Shalimar gardens for romantic couple photographs. Transfer to Srinagar Airport with sweet memories and lifelong bond.

title: Magnificent Kashmir Grand Tour: Complete Valley Experience
shortDescription: The ultimate comprehensive Kashmir journey. Covers all the golden trio destinations: Sonamarg glaciers, Gulmarg snows, and Pahalgam rivers.
fullDescription: For travelers who want to see it all. This 7-day comprehensive itinerary takes you through the full majesty of Kashmir's landscape: from the crystal waters and floating bazaars of Dal Lake, to the snow bridges of Thajiwas Glacier in Sonamarg, the sky-high Gondola summits of Gulmarg, and the roaring turquoise waters of Pahalgam's Lidder River. Designed for families and groups who want a relaxed, complete, and seamless holiday.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Srinagar & Dal Lake Houseboat Experience
itinerary.description: Airport pickup and transfer to your authentic luxury houseboat. Evening Shikara ride across Dal Lake taking in Char Chinar and water lily gardens.

itinerary.title: Full Day Excursion to Sonamarg: The Meadow of Gold
itinerary.description: Full-day scenic drive through the Sindh Valley to Sonamarg. Hike or pony ride to Thajiwas Glacier, view snow bridges, and marvel at high peaks.

itinerary.title: Srinagar to Gulmarg: Into the High Mountains
itinerary.description: Drive to Gulmarg. Experience the Gondola cable car ride, walk across lush meadows, and visit Khilanmarg with panoramic Pir Panjal views.

itinerary.title: Gulmarg to Pahalgam via Saffron Fields & Apple Orchards
itinerary.description: Scenic drive toward Pahalgam. En route see the Pampore saffron fields and walnut groves. Arrive in Pahalgam and unwind by the Lidder River.

itinerary.title: Pahalgam Valley Exploration: Betaab, Aru & Chandanwari
itinerary.description: Explore Betaab Valley, Aru Valley and Chandanwari. Take photos by rushing rapids, indulge in local trout, and enjoy mountain tranquility.

itinerary.title: Pahalgam to Srinagar: Mughal Heritage & Shopping
itinerary.description: Return to Srinagar. Visit Shalimar Bagh, Nishat Bagh, and the historic Jamia Masjid. Enjoy shopping for Pashmina and saffron.

itinerary.title: Farewell Srinagar: Departure
itinerary.description: Breakfast and transfer to Srinagar International Airport for departure with cherished memories of paradise.

title: Offbeat Kashmir: Doodhpathri, Yusmarg & Quiet Trails
shortDescription: Avoid the crowd. Discover the virgin pine glades of Doodhpathri, the serene solitude of Yusmarg, and pastoral village life.
fullDescription: For the discerning traveler who seeks peace, pristine nature, and uncrowded alpine meadows. This journey spotlights Kashmir's best-kept secrets: the milky Shaliganga river of Doodhpathri, the spiritual serenity of Yusmarg with its whispering pine forests and Nilnag lake, combined with the classic charm of Srinagar's heritage backwaters.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Srinagar & Heritage Water Stay
itinerary.description: Arrive in Srinagar. Check in to your houseboat on quiet Nigeen Lake or Dal Lake. Peaceful afternoon Shikara boat ride.

itinerary.title: Day Excursion to Doodhpathri: The Valley of Milk
itinerary.description: Drive through countryside hamlets to Doodhpathri. Walk along the frothy Shaliganga river, breathe pine air, and picnic on lush slopes.

itinerary.title: Day Excursion to Yusmarg: Meadow of Jesus & Nilnag Lake
itinerary.description: Journey to Yusmarg. Hike through fragrant pine woods down to Doodh Ganga or pony ride up to Nilnag Lake. Visit Charar-e-Sharief shrine.

itinerary.title: Srinagar to Pahalgam: Offbeat Shepherd Hamlets
itinerary.description: Drive to Pahalgam. Explore tranquil Aru village, untouched shepherd paths, and scenic Lidder riverside trails.

itinerary.title: Pahalgam Nature Walks & Return to Srinagar
itinerary.description: Morning nature walk in Betaab Valley. Return to Srinagar with an evening visit to the historic old city and local tea shops.

itinerary.title: Departure from Srinagar
itinerary.description: Breakfast and transfer to Srinagar Airport with unforgettable memories of Kashmir's untouched soul.

title: Enchanting Gurez Valley: The Frontier Expedition
shortDescription: Venture into one of Kashmir's most remote paradises. Cross the high Razdan Pass (11,672 ft), admire Habba Khatoon peak, and experience Dardic culture.
fullDescription: A rare journey into the magical frontier of Gurez. Cut off from the outside world for half the year, Gurez retains pure ancestral customs, wooden hamlets, and the majestic pyramid of Habba Khatoon Peak towering above the Kishanganga river. Cross the breathtaking Razdan Pass at 11,672 feet and venture as far as the border settlements of Tulail Valley.

itinerary.title: Srinagar Arrival & Scenic Preparation
itinerary.description: Airport pickup and transfer to hotel/houseboat in Srinagar. Briefing about the mountain journey to Gurez. Evening Shikara ride.

itinerary.title: Srinagar to Gurez Valley via Majestic Razdan Pass
itinerary.description: Early morning drive through Bandipora and ascend to Razdan Pass (11,672 ft) with sweeping Himalayan vistas. Descend into Dawar in Gurez.
itinerary.stay: Overnight in Gurez (Dawar Guest House / Camp)

itinerary.title: Habba Khatoon Peak & Remote Tulail Valley
itinerary.description: Full day discovering Habba Khatoon mountain, natural springs, and driving along the Kishanganga river to the remote villages of Tulail.

itinerary.title: Gurez to Srinagar via Wular Lake Vista
itinerary.description: Scenic drive back across Razdan Pass with views over Wular Lake. Arrive in Srinagar for evening rest and shopping.

itinerary.title: Departure from Srinagar
itinerary.description: Transfer to Srinagar International Airport for departure.

title: WINTER WONDERLAND – KASHMIR PACKAGE
shortDescription: Discover the Magic of Kashmir – A Journey Through Paradise. Experience the enchanting beauty of Kashmir with our Winter Wonderland Package. Explore breathtaking valleys, magnificent Mughal gardens, snow-covered mountains, pristine lakes and unforgettable Himalayan landscapes.
fullDescription:
Discover the Magic of Kashmir – A Journey Through Paradise.

Experience the enchanting beauty of Kashmir with our Winter Wonderland Package. Explore breathtaking valleys, magnificent Mughal gardens, snow-covered mountains, pristine lakes and unforgettable Himalayan landscapes.

Designed specially as a premium Family Package for 5 to 10 persons, featuring dedicated Deluxe Toyota Innova travel, verified deluxe rooms, daily breakfast & dinner, and seamless transfers throughout Kashmir.

itinerary.title: ARRIVAL IN SRINAGAR & LOCAL SIGHTSEEING
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at Srinagar International Airport, our representative will warmly welcome guests. Proceed for local sightseeing. Places to Visit: Shankaracharya Temple (an ancient temple offering panoramic views of Srinagar), Pari Mahal (a beautiful historical monument overlooking Dal Lake), Nishat Bagh (the famous Garden of Bliss), Shalimar Bagh (a magnificent Mughal garden), and Dal Lake Shikara Ride (enjoy a memorable Shikara ride amidst the beautiful surroundings).

itinerary.title: SRINAGAR TO PAHALGAM | THE VALLEY OF SHEPHERDS
itinerary.description: After breakfast, proceed towards Pahalgam, enjoying the scenic beauty of Kashmir along the way. En Route Sightseeing: Saffron Fields, Pampore; Dry Fruits Market; Cricket Bat Factories, Sangam. Pahalgam Sightseeing: Aru Valley, Betaab Valley, Chandanwari, and optional Pony Ride.

itinerary.title: PAHALGAM TO GULMARG | THE MEADOW OF FLOWERS
itinerary.description: After breakfast, proceed towards Gulmarg, enjoying beautiful mountain views and picturesque landscapes. Gulmarg Sightseeing: Gulmarg Meadows, Gulmarg Gondola (subject to availability), Khilanmarg (subject to accessibility), Snow Activities (including skiing, snowboarding and snow biking, at additional cost), and Gulmarg Golf Course.

itinerary.title: GULMARG TO SONAMARG & RETURN TO SRINAGAR
itinerary.description: After breakfast, proceed towards Sonamarg, famously known as the Meadow of Gold. Enjoy breathtaking views of beautiful valleys, rivers and snow-covered mountains. Sonamarg Sightseeing: Thajiwas Glacier, Optional Snow Biking, and Zero Point via local Union Vehicle (subject to weather and road conditions). After sightseeing, return to Srinagar.
places: Zero Point via local Union Vehicle (subject to weather & road conditions)

itinerary.title: DEPARTURE FROM SRINAGAR
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out and proceed towards Srinagar International Airport according to the flight schedule. Guests are advised to reach the airport at least 2 hours before departure. Tour ends with beautiful memories!

responsibleTourism.title: Responsible Tourism – Keep Kashmir Clean
guidelines: Do not throw plastic bottles, wrappers, tissues or food waste on roads, mountains, rivers or sightseeing spots.
Avoid spitting on roads and public places.
Do not damage plants, trees, flowers or natural surroundings.
Respect local culture, traditions, religious places and the people of Kashmir.
Follow safety instructions given by drivers and local authorities.
Help preserve Kashmir's natural beauty for future generations.
